description: Example rules for the synthetic demo. Categorisation is first-match-wins in the order listed. Messaging is mock-only.

rules.description: Students and interns are unlikely buyers; keep them in nurture.
Senior titles at companies with 1,000+ employees.
Recent inbound interest (website, webinar or content download in the last 30 days).
Met at an event or trade show.
Companies with 50-999 employees from any other source.

default.subject: Thanks for your interest, {{first_name|there}}
default.body: Hi {{first_name|there}}, thanks for getting in touch. A member of our team ({{owner}}) will follow up by {{due_date}}. [Synthetic demo message - not sent]

Referral / partner.subject: {{first_name|Hello}}, you were referred to us
Referral / partner.body: Hi {{first_name|there}}, someone suggested we connect about {{company}}. We will call you by {{due_date}}. [Synthetic demo message - not sent]

Event follow-up.subject: Great to meet you at the event, {{first_name|there}}
Event follow-up.body: Hi {{first_name|there}}, thanks for stopping by. We will send the materials we discussed by {{due_date}}. [Synthetic demo message - not sent]
